Hard: thesis fail (named flip/put break) → INVALIDATE alert. Soft: theta tax (long θ$/day bleed ≥ max($10, 1.5% premium) while P&L < +25%) → CLOSE_TRIGGER_REVIEW / θ tax chip. Arm: mfePct ≥ +50% → Armed. Soft giveback: armed AND (mark ≤ 50% of peak OR still-green half-MFE giveback) → CLOSE_TRIGGER_REVIEW . Soft time: DTE ≤ 1 or morning-of-expiry 0DTE → FORCE_REVIEW . Book (Rose/OID): unrealized ≥ +$1k OR ≥ +30% premium → BOOK_CLOSE_REVIEW ; giveback ≥50% of book peak → BOOK_GIVEBACK (soft; never auto-close). Stock BE = projected underlying price for entry breakeven (long call: strike+debit; long put: strike−debit) — not option premium. Seats with a watchlist event in ≤30d show Earn Nd / Evt Nd chips (Events tab). Detail drawer holds In (entry/offer time) / Out (exit/close time) · Greeks / Why / triggers / MFE. Greeks = Δ · θ$/day (click ▾ for γ/IV); soft THETA_TAX when long-premium bleed is large vs a weak P&L. Why = ticket rationale (click ▾ to expand; Rose + Hal fill on elevate). Ticker session labels: RTH = normal hours; PRE-MARKET / AFTER-HOURS = live extended print when available (not RTH); CLOSED shows last RTH + last AH print. Day P&L = option mark vs prior-session close; Week P&L ≈ vs entry (this week). Shown above Total on each section bar. Cost = per-share entryAsk; Qty = contracts; Total $ = Cost × 100 × Qty (cash debit). Leopold Ref cost = ZH bot print (watch only, not a paper fill). Mark from Robinhood option quotes. Multiplier ×100. Leopold watches do not count toward open seats. Shay · 2027 PE watch = equity soft list (shay-semi-watch.json); baseline Fri RTH before post; since-post% vs that close; optional vs SPY; does not consume seats. Shay · key levels (MA) = soft MA blotter (shay-ma-levels-watch.json); Total Trend from EMA9/21 + SMA50/200; softOnly · never elevate alone. Soft watches = pinned research/color only (mu-earnings-watch / be-oe-watch etc.); softOnly · never elevate · do not consume seats. Close triggers: soft seat + Rose-book alerts only (see CLOSE-TRIGGERS-V1.md ); never auto-close / never RH. Day P&L = option mark vs prior-session close; Week P&L ≈ vs entry (this week). Shown above Total on each section bar. Cost = per-share entryAsk; Qty = contracts; Total $ = Cost × 100 × Qty (cash debit). Leopold Ref cost = ZH bot print (watch only, not a paper fill). Mark from Robinhood option quotes. Multiplier ×100. Leopold watches do not count toward open seats. Close triggers: soft seat + Rose-book alerts only (see CLOSE-TRIGGERS-V1.md ); never auto-close / never RH. ## 2 wins

### 1. `OID-PAPER-20260922-4` · QQQ 2026-09-25 745 call · **useful**
- **pnlPct:** +41.97% · **mfePct:** +45.61% · **maePct:** −1.66% · closed · win_exit
- **Why picked:** Best PnL of the week — liquid index FRESH call-wall press with tiny MAE; harvested near peak on Wed reset.
- **Rule update:** Prefer liquid index (QQQ/SPY) call-wall presses when FA is FRESH and spot ≤~0.5–1% under wall into OPEX week; harvest near MFE on DTE≤3.

### 2. `OID-PAPER-20260925-1` · AMZN 2026-10-02 250 call · **useful**
- **pnlPct:** +26.47% · **mfePct:** +26.47% · **maePct:** −16.76% · closed · win_exit (Soft A · approach_fail wall roll)
- **Why picked:** Clean Soft path A validation — harvest into CW 250 green, then cut on FA HARD roll (CW 250→260; old wall became put rail) instead of inventing Path B mid-flight.
- **Rule update:** Soft A = harvest into the named wall; on HARD roll that redefines old CW as put wall (~≥3% under new CW), paper-close green — do not re-anchor the same ticket.

## 2 losses

### 1. `OID-PAPER-20260921-3` · AMZN 2026-09-25 260 call · **never_again**
- **pnlPct:** −60.93% · **mfePct:** +0.00% · **maePct:** −67.69% · closed · loss_exit
